contract.name: Blend v2 lending pool
contract.notes: Codes 1-12 deliberately match the Stellar Asset Contract. Pool-specific codes start at 1200. Most user-facing failures go through submit(), which takes a list of requests (supply, withdraw, borrow, repay, ...).

deployments.label: Blend v2 pool code, shared by every v2 pool

errors.name: InternalError
errors.summary: The pool hit an internal state it should never reach.
errors.explanation: Raised for invariants that should not fail, e.g. interest accrual being run with no time elapsed.
fixes: Retry in a later ledger; if it persists, report it to the Blend team with the transaction hash.

errors.name: AlreadyInitializedError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 pool code.
fixes: If you see #3, check whether the emitting contract is actually a token contract, not the pool.

errors.name: UnauthorizedError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 pool code.
fixes: Check which contract emitted the error; it is most likely a token contract the pool called.

errors.name: NegativeAmountError
errors.summary: A request amount was negative.
fixes: Send non-negative amounts in each Request.

errors.name: BalanceError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 pool code.
errors.explanation: An Error(Contract, #10) inside a pool transaction almost always comes from the underlying token (SAC) when the user's wallet balance is too low to supply or repay.
fixes: Check the user's balance of the asset being supplied or repaid.

errors.name: OverflowError
errors.summary: Declared for SAC parity; not raised by the v2 pool code.
fixes: Check for unscaled or extremely large amounts.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.summary: The pool rejected a malformed request.
errors.explanation: Catch-all for invalid arguments, e.g. adding a reserve past the reserve limit, invalid emission metadata, or emitting too few tokens to avoid rounding issues.
fixes: Re-check the arguments of the call against the Blend v2 docs.

errors.name: InvalidPoolConfigArgs
errors.summary: Pool configuration values are out of range.
errors.explanation: Raised when updating pool config with a backstop take rate of 100% or more, max_positions below 2 or above twice the reserve limit, or a negative min_collateral.
fixes: Keep backstop rate below 1 (7 decimals), max_positions in range, and min_collateral >= 0.

errors.name: InvalidReserveMetadata
errors.summary: The reserve configuration is invalid.
errors.explanation: Interest-rate parameters are out of bounds or out of order (r_one <= r_two <= r_three), reactivity is too high, or an update tries to change decimals or turn an enabled collateral factor off.
fixes: Validate the ReserveConfig fields; decimals cannot change once a reserve exists.

errors.name: InitNotUnlocked
errors.summary: The queued reserve change is still time-locked.
errors.explanation: Reserve additions/changes are queued first and can only be applied after their unlock time.
fixes: Wait until the queued change's unlock_time, then call set_reserve again.

errors.name: StatusNotAllowed
errors.summary: The pool cannot move to the requested status right now.
errors.explanation: Status changes are gated: a pool in Setup or admin-frozen cannot be changed this way, and activating requires the backstop threshold to be met with less than 50% of backstop deposits queued for withdrawal.
fixes: Check the backstop deposit level and queued withdrawals before changing status.

errors.name: InvalidHf
errors.summary: This action would leave the position under-collateralised.
errors.explanation: After applying the requests, the account's health factor would drop below ~1.00001. Borrowing more or withdrawing collateral is refused.
common_causes: Borrowing close to the limit while prices move.
Withdrawing collateral that backs an open loan.
fixes: Borrow less, add collateral, or repay part of the loan first (put the repay request before the withdraw in the same submit).

errors.name: InvalidPoolStatus
errors.summary: The pool's current status does not allow this action.
errors.explanation: Pools that are not active block borrowing (and auction cancellation); frozen pools also block supplying.
fixes: Check the pool status in the Blend UI; repay and withdraw normally still work.

errors.name: InvalidUtilRate
errors.summary: Not enough free liquidity in this reserve.
errors.explanation: The action would push the reserve's utilisation above its configured maximum (for borrows) or to 100% (for withdrawals).
fixes: Borrow or withdraw a smaller amount, or wait for repayments/new supply.

errors.name: MaxPositionsExceeded
errors.summary: The account would exceed the pool's maximum number of positions.
fixes: Close an existing supply/collateral/borrow position in this pool before opening a new one.

errors.name: InternalReserveNotFound
errors.summary: The pool could not find a reserve it expected to have loaded.
fixes: Confirm the asset is a reserve of this pool; otherwise report it with the transaction hash.

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.summary: The oracle price is stale or invalid.
errors.explanation: The oracle's last price is older than 24 hours or is zero/negative.
fixes: Wait for the oracle to update; nothing in the user's transaction can fix this.

errors.name: InvalidLiquidation
errors.summary: This position cannot be liquidated.
errors.explanation: The target is the pool or backstop itself, the percent is 0 or above 100, or the user's collateral still exceeds their liabilities.
fixes: Re-check the position's health and use a liquidation percent between 1 and 100.

errors.name: AuctionInProgress
errors.summary: An auction is already running for this user or the backstop.
fixes: Fill or wait for the existing auction instead of creating a new one.

errors.name: InvalidLiqTooLarge
errors.summary: The liquidation would take too much: post-liquidation health would exceed 1.15.
fixes: Lower the liquidation percent.

errors.name: InvalidLiqTooSmall
errors.summary: The liquidation is too small: post-liquidation health would stay under 1.03.
fixes: Raise the liquidation percent.

errors.name: InterestTooSmall
errors.summary: Accrued interest is below the minimum needed for an interest auction.
errors.explanation: Interest auctions require at least about 200 USDC worth of accrued backstop interest.
fixes: Wait until more interest has accrued.

errors.name: InvalidBTokenMintAmount
errors.summary: The supply amount rounds to zero bTokens.
fixes: Supply a larger amount.

errors.name: InvalidBTokenBurnAmount
errors.summary: The withdraw amount rounds to zero bTokens.
fixes: Withdraw a larger amount.

errors.name: InvalidDTokenMintAmount
errors.summary: The borrow amount rounds to zero dTokens.
fixes: Borrow a larger amount.

errors.name: InvalidDTokenBurnAmount
errors.summary: The repay amount rounds to zero dTokens.
fixes: Repay a larger amount.

errors.name: ExceededSupplyCap
errors.summary: This deposit would exceed the reserve's supply cap.
fixes: Supply less, or wait for withdrawals to free room under the cap.

errors.name: InvalidBid
errors.summary: The auction bid side is empty or not a valid liability.
fixes: Include at least one asset the user actually owes in the auction bid.

errors.name: InvalidLot
errors.summary: The auction lot side is empty or invalid.
errors.explanation: The lot must contain collateral the user holds; for interest auctions it must be exactly the backstop token.
fixes: Include valid collateral (or only the backstop token) in the lot.

errors.name: ReserveDisabled
errors.summary: This reserve is disabled for new supply and borrowing.
fixes: Use another reserve; repaying and withdrawing from this one still works.

errors.name: MinCollateralNotMet
errors.summary: Collateral is below the pool's minimum for borrowing.
errors.explanation: The position is healthy, but its total collateral value is below the pool's min_collateral setting.
fixes: Add more collateral before borrowing.
